mapper.insert: insert into material_stock (material_id, storage_address, available_qty, locked_qty, total_qty, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{materialId}, #{storageAddress}, #{availableQty}, #{lockedQty}, #{totalQty}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, material_id, storage_address, available_qty, locked_qty, total_qty, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock where id = #{id} and is_del = 0

select id, material_id, storage_address, available_qty, locked_qty, total_qty, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock where material_id = #{materialId} and id != #{excludeStockId} and available_qty > 0 and is_del = 0 order by create_time asc, id asc

select id, material_id, storage_address, available_qty, locked_qty, total_qty, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock where material_id = #{materialId} and available_qty > 0 and is_del = 0 order by create_time asc, id asc
mapper.update: update material_stock set available_qty = #{availableQty}, locked_qty = #{lockedQty}, total_qty = #{totalQty}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
update material_stock set available_qty = available_qty - #{lockQty}, locked_qty = locked_qty + #{lockQty}, update_time = now() where id = #{stockId} and available_qty >= #{lockQty} and is_del = 0

update material_stock set available_qty = available_qty + #{releaseQty}, locked_qty = locked_qty - #{releaseQty}, update_time = now() where id = #{stockId} and locked_qty >= #{releaseQty} and is_del = 0
